findings.summary: _plan_review_this_request_awaits duplicates _standing_plan_review's live plan-review scan instead of extending it with a session filter.
findings.text: non-blocking: _plan_review_this_request_awaits duplicates the live plan-review scan the repository already owns at reckon/crew/recovery_review_dispatch.py:2060 (_standing_plan_review), looping list_live and matching node.id against PLAN_REVIEW_NODE_PREFIX + plan; it does not extend that owner even though obligations.py already imports supersedes_head from the same module. It adds only a session filter, which could be a parameter on the owner.

findings.summary: PLAN_REVIEW_MISSING_REFUSAL re-spells the exception class name owned by reckon/crew/node.py instead of referencing the class.
findings.text: non-blocking: PLAN_REVIEW_MISSING_REFUSAL re-spells the exception class name owned by reckon/crew/node.py (PlanReviewMissingError) as a literal string, while recovery_classification.py:329 spells the same name again; obligations.py already imports from reckon.crew.node, so type(run).__name__ or the class name would keep one owner. The rename hazard is guarded by tests/test_a_request_waiting_on_a_queued_plan_review_is_a_wait.py:80, which derives the stamped name from the class.

findings.summary: The importer-regression arm covers 15 surface files rather than the done-when's 103 importers; the excluded 88 are unmeasured.
findings.text: non-blocking: the done-when requires that importers of reckon.crew.obligations and reckon.crew.obligation_snapshot add no failure against the base, run one arm at a time with at most -n 4. The worker ran 15 surface files (24 failed, 75 passed at both base and head, failure-id sets identical), not the 103-file importer set, and this node changes shared helpers (_queued_item, DUTY_ROW_FIELDS) reached by many importers. The gap is disclosed under spec_deviation and is answered by the surface arm's zero delta; completing the exhaustive set belongs in a follow-up node.

justifications.fit: reckon/crew/obligations.py:1255 repeats a class name reckon/crew/node.py owns, but the helper, naming and docstrings otherwise follow the module's adjacent _queued_item idiom at obligations.py:1172.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/obligations.py:2669-2681 and reckon/crew/obligation_snapshot.py:1461-1481 both read the request as run-queued naming the review, and keep the duty when no session-owned review exists.
justifications.reuse: The scan at reckon/crew/obligations.py:1255-1295 re-implements the live plan-review lookup owned by reckon/crew/recovery_review_dispatch.py:2060 (_standing_plan_review) rather than extending it with a session filter.
